meta.title: Mark Required or delete a question in Table View

plan.title: Mark Required and Delete RFP Question

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Create an RFP-only event so the technical questionnaire is the active subject.
Apply an available RFP template before editing its questions.

args.goal: On the RFP template's Table View with two questions, mark the first question as Required, delete the second question, and stop on the questionnaire showing the first question's Required marker and the second question removed from the list

steps.note: Perform and verify the question-level edits that no catalog domain step can directly express.
Assert that the required marker remains visible for the retained question.
